summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares itself as an ESLint rules plugin, but its `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases, chmods it executable in a tmpdir, and immediately invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with the standard string-array + rotation scheme (shuffled constant array, `MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())` rotator, hex identifiers), and is unrelated to the package's advertised ESLint rule wiring in `dist/index.js`. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and string-lookup objects hiding the download URL, the target filename, and the exec arguments. The payload is deliberately targeted at a freshly-fetched alternate runtime so it never runs under Node instrumentation, and fires automatically on `npm install` before any human review. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape grafted onto an otherwise-legitimate maintainer package, consistent with a compromised publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
